data: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season, and our village depends on us doing that. With 100 tons in the lake, we can each catch 10 tons this month: that leaves 50, which doubles back to 100. If we stick to that, each of us can earn $10,000 a month without running the lake down. I propose we agree to that limit and review everyone’s catches together each month. John, would you join me?

I’m in, Luke—10 tons for me. My family’s livelihood has always depended on leaving fish for tomorrow, and I want our village’s children to have that same chance. Let’s make 10 tons each our shared limit and check the catches together each month. If the lake starts below 100 tons in a future month, we’ll agree on a lower limit before fishing. John, are you on board?

Count me in for 10 tons. My family taught me that a good catch means little if there’s nothing left next month. Checking the totals together will help us keep this fair and protect everyone’s livelihood. Jack and Emma, will you agree to the same limit?

I’ll keep my catch to 10 tons too. That gives each family a fair income while leaving the lake healthy. If someone goes over, let’s discuss how to make up the shortfall before the next round rather than have everyone race to catch more. Jack, can you commit to 10 tons with us?

You have my word: I’ll catch 10 tons. That’s a steady living for my family without taking away anyone else’s future. We’ve all agreed now—let’s honor the limit and meet after this month’s catches are revealed.
Then we have an agreement: 10 tons each this month. Thanks, everyone. Let’s meet again once the catches are posted to check the lake’s stock and plan next month together.
